name: Certificate of Achievement (COA) Hindi Language and Culture
program_text: program 11 HNDI - Hindi Hindi Language and Culture COA_Hindi Language and Culture Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) Hindi Language and Culture New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. The Certificate of Achievement in Hindi Language and Culture provides intensive language training to students, equipping them with practical skills essential for navigating the global marketplace. Designed to enhance linguistic proficiency in speaking, listening, reading and writing Hindi, the program also fosters understanding of Indian culture, history and socio-politics. With a focus on meeting the demands of an increasingly interconnected world, the certificate not only satisfies language requirements but also enhances career prospects, particularly in sectors with significant collaboration between the US and India, such as technology. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Demonstrate a consistent working command of essential vocabulary (recognize and reproduce the Hindi alphabet) and language structures necessary to request and provide, orally and in writing, and be able to communicate with native speakers of Hindi, using the appropriate language, style, sensitivity and level of respectfulness on a more complex or abstract range of information relating to high frequency situations in familiar context Demonstrate an increasingly accurate grasp of social protocols and contributions of Hindi-speaking cultures, by analyzing and comparing them to one's own culture De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics. Total Units Students must complete at least 90 degree-applicable quarter units, including required major courses and GE courses At least 24 of those 90 units must be completed at De Anza College All De Anza courses must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 All 90 degree units, including courses transferred from other institutions, must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 General Education Students must complete all requirements for one of the General Education (GE) patterns
